messages:
Ishaan: Hi payroll — noticed my December net pay is much lower than expected. Payslip shows UK PAYE tax AND a separate withholding labeled 'International Withholding' (GBP 1,200 + GBP 450). I live and work in the UK full time.
Joanne: That doesn't sound right. Did you have any bonus or one-off that might be taxed as a supplemental?
Ishaan: No bonus. Just my usual salary plus a small relocation reimbursement in Sep. Everything else normal.
Marta (Payroll): Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the payline or upload the payslip? Also confirm your payroll country on file (should be GB).
Ishaan: Uploaded payslip to case PR-2026-998. Payroll country in Workday: GB, address is UK. Payline snippet: "Gross salary GBP 5,000; PAYE GBP 1,200; NI GBP 400; International Withholding GBP 450"
Harriet (TaxOps): @Marta this looks like the global FX/disbursement path accidentally applied a withholding element intended for US supplemental tax or non-resident tax. If a payroll run used the 'global' compensation element, some roles triggered a separate withholding line.
Marta (Payroll): Action: we'll triage the run and check the element mapping. Ishaan, please attach proof of UK residency (utility bill) and confirm your bank is a GBP account.
Ishaan: Bank is UK GBP. Attached utility.pdf.
Joanne: If this was withheld incorrectly, will you get the money back this month or need a W-2c-style correction?
Harriet (TaxOps): For UK: if withholding was incorrectly applied, we can issue a corrective payslip and process a reimbursement/gross-up in the next run. HMRC reporting may require adjustment if we already submitted a FPS or EPS for the period; we'll handle RTI amendments if needed.
Marta (Payroll): I've created ticket PR-2026-998 and routed to intl-payroll. ETA initial review 3 business days.
PayrollBot: Ticket PR-2026-998 created and assigned to team:intl-payroll. SLA: 3 business days.
Ishaan: Thanks. Please keep me posted; I filed my self-assessment estimated payments and worried this will complicate things.
Harriet (TaxOps): We'll also prepare a short note you can give to your accountant. If a reimbursement happens after year-end, we'll provide a statement for SA filing.
Marta (Payroll): Noted — we'll update the case thread with remediation steps. Leaving open until corrected :thumbsup:
